nodes.label: KB-DB-001: How 2 Database — Deploy PostgreSQL via CloudNativePG & OpenBao
nodes.summary: How 2 database / how to deploy a database: provision a PostgreSQL HA cluster via CloudNativePG (postgresql.cnpg.io/v1) on OpenZFS ZFS storage and inject credentials from OpenBao via ExternalSecret.
steps: Open ticket IT-PLAT-GP-01 (Golden Path database provisioning) and IT-SEC-DB-01 (OpenBao secret path registration).
Create a postgresql.cnpg.io/v1 Cluster manifest with instances: 2 and storageClass: openzfs-iscsi-csi.
Create an external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ExternalSecret pointing to secret/data/<namespace>/<app>-db in OpenBao.
Annotate your application Deployment with reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true" and deploy via the Golden Path deploy-gitops@main component.

nodes.label: KB-GP-002: How 2 Spin Up a 3-Tier Golden Path Project
nodes.summary: How 2 new project / CI/CD pipeline: scaffold a 3-tier application using GitLab CI/CD Golden Path components and ArgoCD GitOps sync.
steps: Request ticket IT-DEMO-GP-01 / IT-PLAT-GP-01 for Golden Path repository intake.
Include gitlab.cluster.example.org/devops/components/golden-path/pipeline@main in .gitlab-ci.yml (never raw script blocks).
Push a feature branch and use the GitLab compare link for human MR review.

nodes.label: KB-GAME-003: How 2 Debug Game Servers (Minecraft / Factorio / Satisfactory)
nodes.summary: How 2 game server debugging: isolate Pod readiness (Layer 1), .cluster.example.org LAN DNS (Layer 2), and client GPU/APU (Layer 3) with Grafana and RunbookGate.
steps: Check game-servers Deployment and Pod readiness (minecraft-survival, minecraft-creative, factorio, satisfactory).
Open https://grafana.cluster.example.org/dashboards and /games to inspect server tick time, container restarts, and host load.
Verify OpenZFS ZFS NFS persistent volume health before running an approved RunbookGate restart runbook.

nodes.label: KB-DNS-004: How 2 Fix .cluster.example.org LAN DNS & NGINX Ingress
nodes.summary: How 2 DNS / ingress: verify NGINX Ingress controller routing, TLS certificates, and AdGuard/Unbound split-horizon DNS for *.cluster.example.org.
steps: Compare direct RFC 1918 LAN IP reachability against the .cluster.example.org hostname.
Verify CoreDNS and ingress-nginx-controller pods are Ready and check TLS certificates in cert-manager.

nodes.label: KB-GPU-005: How 2 Debug GPU / APU & Local LLM Inference
nodes.summary: How 2 GPU / FPS / Ollama: inspect hardware GPU/APU utilization across nodegamma03, nodebeta02, and nodealpha01.
steps: Compare frame times on a second client to isolate local GPU/APU-200 APU thermal throttling from server lag.
Check competing Ollama GPU worker reservations in ai-infra before switching the GPU profile.

nodes.label: KB-OPS-006: How 2 Triage Cluster Health, Node Hotspots & Failed Pods
nodes.summary: How 2 cluster health: inspect node readiness, CPU/RAM hotspots, failed GitLab runner pods, and degraded deployments.
steps: Inspect NotReady node conditions on nodebeta02 and review N-1 drain simulation in /capacity.
Review failed concurrent runner pods in the gitlab namespace and check active SEV incidents in /incidents.

nodes.label: KB-STOR-007: How 2 Storage — OpenZFS ZFS, Democratic-CSI & SeaweedFS
nodes.summary: How 2 storage / PVC: provision PersistentVolumeClaims via democratic-csi (zfs-nfs RWX or openzfs-iscsi-csi RWO) and SeaweedFS S3 buckets.
steps: Select openzfs-iscsi-csi for RWO block workloads (PostgreSQL/CNPG) or zfs-nfs for shared RWX directories.
Declare a PersistentVolumeClaim in your Golden Path Helm/Kustomize manifest and verify Bound status.
For S3 object storage, request a bucket path on SeaweedFS (storage namespace) via OpenBao ExternalSecret.

nodes.label: KB-IAM-008: How 2 Auth / SSO — Authentik OIDC & OpenBao ExternalSecrets
nodes.summary: How 2 auth / SSO / OIDC: protect *.cluster.example.org ingresses with Authentik OAuth2/OIDC providers and OpenBao ExternalSecret credentials.
steps: Register an OAuth2/OIDC Provider and Application in Authentik (iam namespace) and bind group RBAC.
Add nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-url annotations for forward-auth or configure native OIDC client ID via ExternalSecret.
Verify pod security context compliance (runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, drop: [ALL]).

nodes.label: KB-GITOPS-009: How 2 GitOps — ArgoCD Sync & Drift Recovery
nodes.summary: How 2 GitOps / ArgoCD: resolve OutOfSync or Degraded ArgoCD applications and verify Renovate dependency updates.
steps: Push changes on a feature branch with lowercase Conventional Commits and pass the 6-gate CI pipeline.
Open the GitLab compare link for human review and merge to main.
Verify ArgoCD Application sync status at https://argocd.cluster.example.org and monitor pod rollout.
